purpose: Mechanically prove the Global-v2 partition, capability separation, clean-room tutorial metric, deterministic model-stage interfaces, receipt binding, and fail-closed publication on synthetic data before any official numeric target or model operation.
targeted_failure_modes: component leakage between development and confirmatory roots
confirmatory truth visible to a predictor or candidate freezer
development targets visible to a confirmatory predictor
candidate or prediction not bound to its exact upstream capability
metric formula, endpoint masking, denominator, or macro mismatch
receipt-after-parse, symlink, traversal, or overwrite acceptance
accidental official, blinded-test, TDI, submission, or leaderboard capability

implementation.dependencies: Python standard library plus existing core utilities only; no research dependency is added

synthetic_source.complete_rule: point, low, and high are finite and low <= point <= high
synthetic_source.missing_rule: point, low, and high are all empty
synthetic_source.receipt_order: Authenticate the exact immutable source root and manifest receipt before parsing either CSV

partition.arithmetic: First eight SHA256 bytes interpreted unsigned big-endian modulo 5; zero is confirmatory and all other values are development
invariants: one molecule has exactly one component hash
one component appears in exactly one partition
target availability and values never enter assignment
input order cannot change assignment or output bytes
reseed, rebalance, and post-target reassignment are forbidden

may_contain: confirmatory synthetic truth and reported bounds

metric.eligible: complete rows only; predictions must cover every eligible key exactly and may include prediction-only keys that are ignored by the scorer
metric.denominator: using the arithmetic mean of eligible central points as every baseline prediction, apply the identical bound-distance sum
metric.denominator_failure: nonpositive or nonfinite denominator fails closed
metric.macro: plain arithmetic mean of the four endpoint values in canonical endpoint order
metric.name_boundary: Passing parity establishes only the pinned tutorial calculation on contracted synthetic fixtures. It does not establish live-backend parity and must never be called an official score.

synthetic_stage_sequence: compile three disjoint immutable capability roots
fit deterministic endpoint means from development capability only
predict from candidate plus label-free confirmatory capability only
score once from prediction plus sealed truth capability
required_adversarial_tests: two fresh roots replay to byte-identical relative file maps
row-order permutation preserves every derived byte
component partition is disjoint and exhaustive
target magnitude and availability changes cannot change membership
predictor root contains no numeric truth or bounds
development root contains no confirmatory molecule
wrong receipt, malformed hash, duplicate key, nonfinite value, invalid bound, symlink, traversal, and overwrite fail closed
candidate cannot consume scorer capability and scorer cannot consume development capability
prediction and truth from different compilation roots cannot be combined
second publication to a consumed scorer destination is rejected
next_gate: After accepted synthetic evidence and reviewed integration, draft a distinct G2-2 MapLight reproduction execution contract bound to exact implementation-source receipts. Do not open official inputs under this G2-1 contract.
